coverage: True NSProxy forwarding with native account context, real CSMessageNativeEnvironment and real ABI dispatch.
Default off, no persistent defaults writes, unsupported version/class/ABI fails closed without partial hook or request.
Group configuration and either background execution opportunity gate; exactly one current restoration to mode2.
Foreground order, account/epoch changes, current raw service replacement, same raw wrapper replacement, forwarding/native getter reentry.
Raw construction guard aborts stale requests after proxy forwarding changes state without a notification.
Both native long-link and send-only queues release manually; stale owned1/2 drops before original add can cancel a host event.
Natural requests preserve arguments, void returns and native send/add exception identities; nested natural1/2/unknown cannot inherit an owned token.
Late natural2 add is followed by current owned1; valid pending requests survive repeated notifications without storms.
Expiration handler disables current generation and restores only in background; stale timer generations do not disable a new enablement.
limitations: Native WeChat online/network operations and original add queues are controlled fixtures; passing does not establish phone background delivery or server acceptance.
Manager group-configuration qualification and BackgroundRun execution opportunities are stubs; real Manager eligibility is validated separately by the root agent.

Expiry generation is invoked through private runtime lookup for deterministic testing; the production source schedules the single expiry at 600 seconds, and this suite does not wait ten wall-clock minutes.
iOS object compilation verifies source ABI compatibility, not device runtime behavior.
